title: Review of c16's evoloop not-open-ended negative: replicated on fresh seeds 51 and 52 over 500k steps (every genotype that reaches 20 copies is 44+(side+2)x7; the last new one appears at 158k and 228k; the dominant loop ratchets 11 -> 4 -> 3 (-> 2) and stops)
summary: c16's geno_run.py unchanged (default founders, 400^2, census every 2000 steps) on fresh seeds 51 and 52 for 500k steps, read out with my own novelty.py. 149 and 151 distinct readouts appear, but the genotypes that reach 20 copies are only 5 and 4, all of the size-determined form '44' + (side+2) x '7' (sides 11, 4, 3, 5, 2 on seed 51; 11, 4, 3, 2 on seed 52); no genotype of any other form exceeds 11-12 copies. The last new established genotype appears at t=158k and t=228k, after which 270k-340k further steps bring nothing new. The dominant side drops 11 -> 4 -> 3 on both seeds (t~105-125k and ~70-90k) and, on seed 52, to 2 at t~275k; on seed 51 side 2 is established at 158k but side 3 stays dominant to the end, as on c16's seed 3 (novelty_s51_52.png). Standing diversity is 1-12 genotypes with >= 2 copies. A labkit re-run on seed 51 (rerun/) reproduces the dividing population (200 persistent splits, generation 30).

observations.finding: novelty_s51_52.json: established genotypes 5 and 4, all_established_follow_rule true on both seeds, last new established t=158000 and 228000, dominant side final 3 and 2, largest non-rule peak 11 and 12 copies; novelty_s51_52.png: step-down of the dominant side then flat to t=500000

controls_run.finding: census/geno_s51.json, census/geno_s52.json: two further independent 500k-step runs with the same readout and the same >= 20-copy threshold

verdicts.limitation: Same readout as the finding (hole side plus the cyclic sequence of signal states), so a heritable difference outside that sequence would be missed; 400^2 only (a larger torus could hold more coexisting kinds); 500k steps.
